name: company-card
title: Company card
description: A company at a glance for CRMs and directories: logo, name, domain, status, and facts for industry, size, place, owner and last contact.
docs: name is the one primary link of the card (href, or onOpen for a button); the whole card opens it. domain is the website, with or without the scheme and the path (https://www.halcyon-freight.com/about shows halcyon-freight.com) and opens in a new tab, with that said in the link for screen readers. The logo is an image address; without one, or while it loads, the card shows the initials of the name. size is a number (written 240 employees) or your own words. owner is { name, image? }. lastContact is a date written in words (3 days ago, yesterday) with the exact date in a tooltip a tap opens too; null says Not contacted yet and leaving it out shows no line. status is lead, prospect, customer or lost: a badge with its own glyph, weight and word. Facts you leave out leave no empty row. Pass now to pin the clock for server HTML and tests; otherwise the card reads the browser clock after the first paint and writes the date until then. labels carries every word.
